title: Water Under Pressure

beats.narrativeText: The station's water recycling system has partially failed.
Something is preventing water from moving properly through the outpost.
The learner traces how water flows through the station's systems.
Diagrams and simple experiments begin to reveal where the malfunction is occurring.
The learner must interpret the diagrams and recommend a repair.
The learner identifies the source of the malfunction and proposes a fix.
The learner reflects on how water shortages may have influenced the expedition's earlier decisions.
Repairing the system restores another section of the station, and additional laboratories become accessible.

activities.title: Trace Water Flow
activities.storyContext: The station's water recycling system has partially failed, and water isn't moving properly through the outpost.
activities.instructions: Trace how water is meant to flow through the station's systems, following the pipework diagram.
activities.output: A traced path of the station's water flow.

activities.title: Conduct Simple Experiments
activities.storyContext: Testing is the best way to find out where the flow is being blocked.
activities.instructions: Conduct a simple experiment to test where water flow might be interrupted.
activities.output: Results from a simple water-flow experiment.

activities.title: Interpret Diagrams
activities.storyContext: The station's engineering diagrams hold clues about where the system might be failing.
activities.instructions: Interpret the water system diagrams to identify where the malfunction is most likely occurring.
activities.output: A diagram interpretation identifying the likely fault.

activities.title: Recommend Repairs
activities.storyContext: A clear recommendation will help Atlas carry out the repair.
activities.instructions: Write a recommendation explaining what repair should be made and why.

activities.title: Design a More Efficient Water System
activities.storyContext: The current system could be improved, not just repaired.
activities.instructions: Design a more efficient water recycling system for the station.
activities.output: A design for an improved water recycling system.

activities.title: Water Recycling in Space
activities.storyContext: Water recycling is a critical challenge for remote research stations and spacecraft alike.
activities.instructions: Find out how water is recycled aboard spacecraft or remote research stations.
activities.output: None required — this is an open investigation.

prompts: How did tracing the water flow help you find the malfunction?

discussionPoints: What clues helped you find the cause of the malfunction?
Why might water shortages have affected the expedition's decisions?
parentGuide.preparation: No special preparation required; a simple container of water can help demonstrate flow if useful.
parentGuide.assessment: Look for a repair recommendation clearly linked to evidence from the diagrams and experiments.

completionCriteria: Water flow traced, diagrams interpreted, and repairs recommended.
